mapper.select: SELECT o.*, g.book_name as goods_name, SUBSTRING_INDEX(g.images, ',', 1) as goods_image, buyer.nick_name as buyer_name, buyer.avatar as buyer_avatar, seller.nick_name as seller_name, seller.avatar as seller_avatar FROM `order` o LEFT JOIN goods g ON o.goods_id = g.id LEFT JOIN user buyer ON o.buyer_id = buyer.id LEFT JOIN user seller ON o.seller_id = seller.id WHERE o.id = #{id}

SELECT COUNT(CASE WHEN buyer_id = #{userId} THEN 1 END) as buyCount, COUNT(CASE WHEN seller_id = #{userId} THEN 1 END) as sellCount, COUNT(CASE WHEN (buyer_id = #{userId} OR seller_id = #{userId}) AND status = 0 THEN 1 END) as pendingCount, COUNT(CASE WHEN (buyer_id = #{userId} OR seller_id = #{userId}) AND status = 2 THEN 1 END) as finishedCount FROM `order` WHERE buyer_id = #{userId} OR seller_id = #{userId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO `order` ( order_no, goods_id, buyer_id, seller_id, price, status, buyer_message, trade_location ) VALUES ( #{orderNo}, #{goodsId}, #{buyerId}, #{sellerId}, #{price}, #{status}, #{buyerMessage}, #{tradeLocation} )
